node.statement: Coordinate identity and radius: substitute U=sJ bold-dot(J+A+G(A)), W=sJ bold-dot(J+B+G(B)), and U^dagger=W bold-dot(J+Q) into the typed factorization and cancel the scalar s. This gives the exact identity J-A+G(A)=(J+B+G(B)) bold-dot(J+Q). Its anti-Hermitian projection is -A=B+P^par((B+G(B)) bold-dot Q). Using ||G(B)||<=d||B|| and the preceding Q bound, choose the C_der smallness cutoff so that (1+epsilon_r)(1+d)||Q||<=1/2. Then ||B||<=r+(1/2)||B||, hence ||B||<=2r.
